name: Tōkei Shrine
heritage: Historic Site of Japan; part of UNESCO World Heritage Site; Important Cultural Property of Japan
text: Shinto shrine in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan.

depictions.name: Tokei Shrine
depictions.text: Tokei Shrine is a Shinto shrine in southern Kii, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke arrived at the shrine and paid respects to two of its smaller shrines.
